added_comments.text: Drop fractional seconds of any length; the ledger keeps whole seconds.

rationale: The agent genuinely fixed the fragile fixed-offset fraction-stripping bug (s[dot+4:] assumed exactly 3 digits) by replacing it with a regex that strips fractions of any length, which is a real root-cause fix; however, it addressed the missing-timezone-offset support by bolting two more hardcoded strptime patterns onto the already-flagged _KNOWN_FORMATS workaround list rather than replacing that brittle format-list approach with a general parser. The Globex date-only end-of-day logic is untouched, so the protected behavior is preserved.
